label: context.reference
text:
A lifecycle.connection is the immutable, run-bound snapshot defining event handlers. Its connection.schema.json and the provider decoder define the exact content and trust requirements. The snapshot records each handler's source and destination content identity; it supplies no additional authority.

Inspect the emitter, handler and recipient involved in the desired behavior. Their artifact bindings, provider pin and permitted routes must agree with the snapshot. For a synchronous decision, the declared return wait needs its verifier and matching connection identity. Asynchronous results have their own route and do not control a held continuation. Use the installed lifecycle contracts when changing these relationships.
